Class Players

java.lang.Object
entities.players.Players
Direct Known Subclasses:
NonPlayable, Playable
public abstract class Players extends Object
Abstract class representing a player or non-player character in the game. This class contains all common properties and methods for characters, such as health, position, movement, attack, sprites, and interaction with items.
